# Evaluation report

One report per release. Replace each placeholder line with your own text.

## Metrics

Which metrics were chosen, and why?

Macro F1 and recall for the urgent class were the metrics, chosen because missed urgent tickets cost most.

## Dataset

Which test set or benchmark was used, and how was it kept apart from training?

A held-out test set of 4,000 tickets from the latest quarter was used and never seen in training.

## Results

What did each metric score against its threshold?

F1 scored 0.82 against a release threshold of 0.80, so the evaluation result passed.

## Decision

Did the release pass, and who signed it off?

The release passed and the Example Ltd service desk lead signed it off.
